MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper fits my recent purchases because it would help me measure screws and shafts when matching metric bolts and push-on washers.",
    "Recommending a measuring tool understood that a useful next purchase could support using the hardware I already bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge and thermal camera serve specific inspection tasks that I have not shown a need for; owning hardware does not make those tools useful to me now.",
    "The #10-24 tap kit does not match my recent metric fasteners, and buying bolts does not imply I need to cut threads.",
    "Wire connectors and repair tape assume electrical work or leaks, while the medical supplies and soap dispenser have no clear connection to my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "The suggestions stretched from practical hardware into unrelated household and medical supplies without a reason I would need them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific dimensions and metric sizing of my fasteners matter more than a broad connection to tools.",
    "My recent purchases center on fastening and magnetic mounting, so a recommendation needs a clear use alongside those items to make me act.",
    "I rarely interact unless something meets a concrete need; a possible future repair is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The caliper understood my need to match hardware, but most suggestions stretched that intent into unrelated tools and supplies."
}
